statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is ordered to correlate transient symptoms with potential arrhythmic events or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry is medically necessary for this patient
